content: लुप्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [लुप्-क्त] .²1 Broken, violated, injured, destroyed. .²2 Lost, deprived of; सा लुप्तसंज्ञा न विवेद दुःखम् <ls>R. 14. 56</ls>; परिवृतनाभि लुप्तत्रिवलि श्यामस्तनाग्रमलसाक्षि <ls>Govardhanāchārya</ls>. .²3 Robbed, plundered. .²4 Dropped, elided, disappeared (in <ab>gram.</ab>). .²5 Omitted, neglected. .²6 Obsolete, disused, out of use; see लुप्. .²7 Elliptical (as <ab>opp.</ab> to पूर्ण, in <ab>Rhet.</ab>). .{@-प्तम्@} Stolen property, booty.
